Hi Mateo and team,

Summary of the Hartford gate check-in incident:

Scheduling stayed available from the dispatch office throughout, since the issue was gate check-in only. The incident stays open for one more arrival cycle. The separate status-page access issue is still being chased under INC-4821.

Gideon
